description: This file defines the ErfC class which implements the complementary error function (ERFC) calculations, including handling array inputs and integrating with Excel error reporting.

classes.name: ErfC
classes.description: Provides functions to compute the complementary error function (ERFC), including handling array inputs and recursive approximation for larger values.

methods.name: ERFC
methods.description: Calculates the complementary ERF function for a given input or array of inputs, using either direct computation or array evaluation handling.

methods.name: erfcValue
methods.description: Calculates the ERFC value for a single numeric input, using different approximation methods depending on the magnitude of the input.
